summary: Ubisoft Montpellier's Valiant Hearts games are UbiArt-powered historical puzzle adventures focused on World War I stories, documents, and accessible comic-book presentation.

entries.title: Valiant Hearts: The Great War

emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Current PC build with storefront/login state documented

primary.why: The PC release is current and capture-friendly, and Steam/Ubisoft pages still list the game as available. It preserves the UbiArt comic-book adventure route while avoiding the input and storefront caveats of older mobile/console versions.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current PC release from Steam or Ubisoft Connect. Record storefront, Ubisoft Connect requirement, build, chapter, collectibles/historical facts, controller or keyboard/mouse, language/subtitles, achievements, and whether console/mobile routes were compared.

secondary.why: PC is the easiest current capture route.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record Ubisoft Connect/login and achievement state; do not merge with Valiant Hearts: Coming Home.
